enhance_prompts.prompt: structure: [Genre, Vocal Details, Arrangement]; rules:; - Genre block first: era + region + 2-3 style anchors + tempo in BPM + key if known; - Vocal Details block: gender, register, delivery manner, one signature texture; - Arrangement block: the instrument story front to back — intro, build, drop, outro; - name production adjectives the ear can verify (dusty, wide, brickwalled); - never write lyric content in the caption — that lives in the lyrics field
enhance_prompts.lyrics: structure: [section tags, rhyme, hook law]; rules:; - every section wrapped in [tag]: [verse] [pre-chorus] [chorus] [bridge] [outro]; - keep verses concrete and grounded; the chorus earns the abstraction; - the hook repeats at least once, word-for-word; - short lines sing: 6-9 syllables default, break longer thoughts; - match the section energy to the arrangement block it sits over

fields.name: prompt
fields.label: Tags / Description
fields.tooltip: Structured caption: Genre + Vocal Details + Arrangement. E.g. 'funk, pop, soul, guitar, 105 BPM'.

fields.name: lyrics
fields.label: Lyrics
fields.tooltip: Lyrics with structure tags: [verse], [chorus], [bridge]. Empty = instrumental.

fields.name: guidance_scale
fields.label: CFG
fields.tooltip: Classifier-free guidance. IGNORED on Turbo (distilled weights — engine applies none); Base/SFT: 3.0-10.0, 7.0 recommended.

fields.name: n_diffusion_steps
fields.label: Diffusion Steps
fields.tooltip: Flow-matching denoising steps. 8 = Turbo default (engine clamps Turbo to 8); Base recommended 32-50. Never 0.

fields.name: negative_prompt
fields.label: Negative Prompt
fields.tooltip: Excludes unwanted musical traits (e.g. 'muddy bass, clipping, harsh vocals').

fields.name: language
fields.label: Vocal Language
fields.tooltip: Vocal language for lyric/phoneme alignment. Default 'en' = English.

fields.name: temperature
fields.label: Temperature
fields.tooltip: LM planner temperature (song structure/lyrics). 0.7 default; 0.3-0.5 = predictable structures.
